howItWorks.title: How it works:
steps: Enter your ground truth (the correct text)
For each processor you want to test, add an input and paste its OCR'd text
Click "Run Comparison" to calculate all metrics
View the generated HTML report with detailed comparison

tips.text: You can test as many processors as you want by clicking "+ Add Processor"
